local_first_rows.clause: Clef serves a family only where a committed receipt shows it non-inferior to Jev within a preregistered margin under the same calibration; otherwise Jev. Clef runs through localbench's gateway (localbench kit-jtq2, tracked by a jev bead); if that gateway is not delivered, Clef stays out of stage 1 and every family keeps Jev or its rule incumbent. Stage 1 measures Clef-Flash on the gate and screen family suites only (X2); other families keep Jev or their rule/encoder winner, and full Clef (51 GB) is DROPPED from stage 1 (jev-52s0 records the decision and its provenance).
